svg.title: SuperHost — Newspaper layout — colour reconstruction
svg.desc: Expect the most. SuperHost. Reconstructed from the historical reference with twelve unchanged PofBC flag paths, analytic star primitives, and custom letterforms. All artwork is editable vector geometry. No embedded raster or font dependency. Colour interpretation using the PofBC source flag palette; original SuperHost printing inks have not been authenticated.
